facts.fact: Eravi's green clay-and-bark salve was left in thanks by Fourth Guard, who came to the dispensary for a blistered heel; it smells of scorched tamarind and pine sap. Neela keeps the pot.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Eravi salve her split nails with a resin-smelling salve; the source is the minimal link to the escort.

facts.fact: Rema tells Neela she will be sworn at the assize as household witness to the closing writ.
facts.why: needed because the chapter's out-question concerns what Neela will say under oath.

facts.fact: Devan loosed the fourteen hounds at dusk on the day of ch 3; they had been kennelled through the nine days of rain.
facts.why: needed because the outline has the hounds running the yard loose again.

facts.fact: Janu counts eleven servants' names Neela has learned beyond the household she was introduced to; the hall has eight pillars.
facts.why: small texture used in the hall scene.

facts.fact: First Guard's hand goes to her own left cuff when she sees the binding on Neela's wrist.
facts.why: plants clue C04 at the peak of Rema's questioning.
